required_controls: checkpoint write requires a current leased running Attempt and current WorkUnit state version
checkpoint id is versioned append-only and expected checkpoint version rejects stale writes
checkpoint artifact row and CHECKPOINT_VERSION_CREATED event are committed in one canonical transaction
checkpoint payload is content-addressed and recovery read requires exact artifact version plus digest verification
superseding version must name the immediate prior exact artifact version and prior versions remain readable
checkpoint metadata records schema ref, snapshot digest, producer Attempt and input head
atomicity_boundary: SQLite canonical artifact row, event and idempotency receipt are atomic. A content-addressed object written before a later transaction abort can be physically unreferenced, but never gains canonical checkpoint identity or recovery visibility.
